data.completion_memo: Implemented the persistent desktop workbench shell: navigation order, accepted compact pane geometry, responsive inspector drawer, keyboard-visible focus, status, accessible controls, and native-presentation facade integration point.
data.description: Implement the persistent desktop navigation order, routing, resizable/collapsible panes, inspector drawer breakpoints, shortcuts, connection/stale banners, and focus restoration to the accepted geometry. Define the narrow Aworkit native-presentation port and accessible in-workbench fallbacks for menus, dialogs, and notifications; native OS bindings are owned by M12.4.
data.title: M07.3 — Implement the desktop shell, navigation, panes, and native-presentation port
